items.difficulty_reason: The lemma associates to a short exact sequence of differential objects a long exact sequence of homology objects (statement lines 5723-5731). The proof is a complete argument: the sequence of differential objects is displayed as a short exact sequence of complexes by repeating it degree by degree with the differentials as the vertical arrows, and the cited lemma on the long exact cohomology sequence of such a sequence is applied to it, the terms being identified as the homology of the differential objects (proof lines 5733-5745). The non-formal content is the conversion of differential objects into periodic complexes. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
